retrieval.scope: Three compact aggregate-only public-data results; no raw event-level records were downloaded or committed.

source_public_data_snapshot.scope: Observed Google public-sample retrieval metadata and checksums for aggregate-only outputs; not a raw event snapshot.

synthetic_test_fixture.scope: Small deterministic synthetic schema test fixture only; not observed Google data and not a public-data snapshot.

limitations: The fixture validates schema handling only and must not be used to infer public-source distributions or outcomes.
Observed findings are computed only from the compact public aggregate outputs, never from the synthetic fixture.
The public sample is obfuscated; aggregate paths omit user, session, transaction, and hashed identifiers.
